metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: The key whose value must match the asset name (ie. something like 'm_Model' if you want to apply this tag to .vmdl assets that are referenced by the vdata file)

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value:
This expression determines whether the tag should actually be applied to an asset
It will be evaluated against vdata entries where the key matches the asset - if any of them evaluate to true the tag will be applied.
Most simple expressions involving the VData keys are supported. Use 'true' to tag unconditionally.

annotations.description: True during the buy phase (freeze time) at the start of each round.
annotations.notes: Players cannot move while this is true; buy menus open automatically.

annotations.description: True while the pre-match warmup is active.

GameTime at which the current warmup period started.
True while the Terrorist team's tactical time-out is in progress.
True while the Counter-Terrorist team's tactical time-out is in progress.
Seconds remaining in the active Terrorist time-out.
Seconds remaining in the active CT time-out.
Number of tactical time-outs the T-side has used so far in the match.
Number of tactical time-outs the CT-side has used so far in the match.
True during a technical pause (admin-issued, not team time-out).
True when the match is paused and waiting for both teams to confirm resumption.
Freeze-time duration in seconds (mirrors mp_freezetime convar value).
Round time limit in seconds (mirrors mp_roundtime_* convar value).
Unix-epoch float of when the match (not the round) began.
GameTime at which the current round's freeze time ended and play started.
GameTime at which the current round will be force-restarted by the server (0 = no pending restart).
True in the brief window between a restart being triggered and the new round spawning.
GameTime at which the first live round of the match started (after all warmup/knife rounds).
Countdown in seconds until the next phase (round, half, overtime) begins; drives the on-screen timer.
Game-phase enum: 1 = First Half, 2 = Second Half, 3 = Pre-overtime, 4 = Overtime, 5 = Game Over.

annotations.description: Total number of rounds completed since the match started (all phases combined).
Number of rounds played in the current phase (half/overtime period).
Number of overtime periods played so far (0 = regulation).
Number of hostages that have not yet been rescued or killed.
True once any hostage has reached the rescue zone this round.
True when the map has at least one bomb-plant zone (bombsite entity).
True when the map has at least one hostage rescue zone.
True when the map has at least one buy zone.
True when the server is running a matchmaking (Valve-hosted) game rather than a community server.
Matchmaking mode identifier (0 = casual, 1 = competitive, etc.).
True when the server is an official Valve dedicated server.
True when the server is running a workshop or demo map that does not count for match records.
Number of spectator slots available on this server.
Platform/device identifier for the match (used by Valve matchmaking for stats reporting).
True from the moment the first live round begins; remains true until the match ends.
Index within the server's map-group of the map that will be played next.
Display name of the tournament/event shown in the HUD scoreboard (up to 512 bytes).
Stage label for the tournament event (e.g. 'Grand Final', 'Quarterfinal').
Match-stats summary text displayed in the scoreboard (tournament use).
GameTime at which the post-match item-drop reveal animation begins.
GameTime at which the post-match item-drop reveal animation ends.
True while the post-match item-drop animation is playing.
True when the current match is eligible for operation mission progress.
True when at least one GOTV/HLTV spectator slot is connected.
True while the planted bomb entity is active and ticking.
Array of up to 100 item-definition indices that are prohibited from being used in this match (e.g. tournament bans).
Best-of-N series length configured for this match (e.g. 1, 3, 5).
True while the bomb (C4) is lying on the ground, not carried by any player.
Which team won the most-recently completed round (0 = not over, 2 = Terrorist win, 3 = CT win).
RoundWinReason_t enum: 1 = target bombed, 7 = bomb defused, 8 = all T killed, 9 = hostage rescued, etc.
True when the Terrorist team is currently locked out of purchasing weapons.
True when the Counter-Terrorist team is currently locked out of purchasing weapons.
Array of 30 round-result codes (one per round slot) used to fill the scoreboard half-time panel.
Array of 30 values – number of CT players alive at the end of each round.
Array of 30 values – number of T players alive at the end of each round.
World-space minimum corner of the minimap bounding box.
World-space maximum corner of the minimap bounding box.
Array of 8 height values dividing the map into vertical sections for the radar's floor-switching feature.
Array of 10 vote-type codes for the end-of-match map vote options.
Array of 10 map-group option indices corresponding to the vote types.
Index of the winning map-vote option (-1 while voting is in progress).
Number of consecutive rounds the CT side has lost; drives the loss-bonus economy.
Number of consecutive rounds the T side has lost; drives the loss-bonus economy.
Reason code for an early match abort (0 = not aborted, non-zero codes map to abandonment reasons).

annotations.description: The server-side controller entity for a CS2 player.  One CCSPlayerController exists per connected client for the lifetime of the connection; it persists across rounds.  The controller owns a CCSPlayerPawn (the physical in-world representation) which may be recreated each round.
annotations.notes: The controller / pawn split mirrors the Source 2 architecture described in the HL2SDK: a lightweight controller manages session-level state (score, team, competitive rank) while the pawn carries per-round physics and animation state.  Demo parsers should track m_hPlayerPawn to find the corresponding pawn entity handle each round.

annotations.description: The server-side controller entity for a CS2 player.  One CCSPlayerController exists per connected client for the lifetime of the connection; it persists across rounds.  The controller owns a CCSPlayerPawn (the physical in-world representation) which may be recreated each round.
annotations.notes: The controller / pawn split mirrors the Source 2 architecture described in the HL2SDK: a lightweight controller manages session-level state (score, team, competitive rank) while the pawn carries per-round physics and animation state.  Demo parsers should track m_hPlayerPawn to find the corresponding pawn entity handle each round.

annotations.description: Pointer to CCSPlayer_BulletServices which tracks hit counts registered on the server.
Pointer to CCSPlayer_HostageServices which tracks which hostage entity this player is currently carrying.
Pointer to CCSPlayer_BuyServices which tracks sellback purchase history for the current round.
Pointer to CCSPlayer_ActionTrackingServices which tracks weapon purchases and rescue state for stats/scoring.
True when the equipped agent skin uses a female voice pack.
Human-readable area/landmark name from the nav mesh where the player was last located (e.g. 'CTSpawn', 'BombsiteA').
True while the player is standing inside a buy zone.
True while the player is inside a hostage rescue zone.
True while the player is standing inside a bomb-plant zone (bombsite trigger).
annotations.notes: m_nWhichBombZone indicates which site (0 = not in any, 1 = A, 2 = B).

annotations.description: Retakes-mode offering index: which weapon/utility load-out this player was offered for the retake.
Card index the player selected in the retakes offering interface.
True when the retakes system has granted this player a defuse kit for the retake round.
True if this player earned the retakes MVP award in the previous round.
Item definition index of the bonus item awarded to the retakes MVP.
GameTime at which the health-shot (medshot) movement speed boost expires.
True while the player's buy menu is open.
GameTime of the most-recent damage event that reduced this player's health.
Bone index of the last hit that caused a ragdoll impulse.
World-space impulse vector applied to the ragdoll bone on death.
Class name of the weapon that killed this player (used to select the correct death ragdoll).
True if the fatal blow was a headshot, used to trigger headshot-specific ragdoll animation.
World-space position of the player's origin at the moment of death.
CEconItemView describing the glove skin equipped on this player.
Incremented each time the glove loadout changes, so the client can refresh the glove model.
Eye angles at the moment of death, used to pose the ragdoll's head correctly.
True when the player has switched the weapon to the left hand (cl_lefthand 1).
GameTime at which the player last toggled handedness (prevents rapid toggling).
Custom viewmodel X offset in world units (cl_viewmodel_offset_x).
Custom viewmodel Y offset in world units (cl_viewmodel_offset_y).
Custom viewmodel Z offset in world units (cl_viewmodel_offset_z).
Custom viewmodel FOV in degrees (cl_viewmodel_fov; clamped to 60–68).
True while the player is in walk mode (shift-walk / cl_showpos = 1 walking).
Entity index of the player or entity that last killed this pawn.
EntitySpottedState_t struct tracking which players have spotted (ESP-radar dot) this entity.
annotations.notes: See also m_bSpotted and the spotted bitmask used by the minimap.

annotations.description: True while the player is looking through a weapon scope.
True when the scope should be re-engaged automatically after the next shot (AWP/SSG 08 bolt-action mechanic).
True while the player is actively defusing the planted bomb.
True while the player is picking up a hostage entity.
CSPlayerBlockingUseAction_t enum indicating a use-action in progress that blocks other actions (e.g. defuse, hostage grab).
GameTime of the next footstep sound emission; controls footstep sound spacing.
True when the player is in a location where defusing is not permitted.
Indicates which bomb site the player is currently inside (0 = none, 1 = A, 2 = B).
Number of bullets fired since the player last stopped firing (resets when trigger is released or weapon changes).
annotations.notes: Used to drive the walk-run bobbing animation state.

annotations.description: Accumulated flinch value from recent damage; drives the camera-shake magnitude.
annotations.notes: Only sent to the owning player (LocalPlayerExclusive).

annotations.description: Multiplicative speed modifier applied on top of base movement speed (0.0–1.0 typically; reduced while injured or tased).
True when the weapon's fire input must be fully released before the next shot is accepted (prevents auto-fire on re-deploy).
True if the killing blow on this player was a headshot.
Current armor HP (0–100). Combined-arms note: vest+helmet does not exceed 100 armor points.
Total buy value (in dollars) of equipment currently held by the player.
Equipment value at the start of the current round (after freeze-time buy phase ends).
Equipment value at the moment freeze time ended.
Array of 5 item-definition indices for the agent patch slots (team patches worn on the uniform).
Color applied to the player model while gun-game immunity is active.
GameTime until which the player is immune to damage in Gun Game / Arms Race mode.
True while the player has gun-game spawn immunity (brief invincibility after spawning in Arms Race mode).
GameTime at which molotov/incendiary damage will next be applied to this player.
Server-authoritative eye angles (pitch, yaw, roll) used for hit-box calculation and third-person rendering.
annotations.notes: Encoded at full qangle_precise precision. The definitive source for a player's look direction.

annotations.description: The physical in-world representation of a CS2 player.  Carries per-round state: health, armor, position, animations, and weapon inventory.  A new CCSPlayerPawn is created each round on (re)spawn; the corresponding CCSPlayerController persists across rounds.
annotations.notes: Source 2 architecture separates the controller (session/connection state) from the pawn (physics/animation state).  Demo parsers must follow m_hController → CCSPlayerController to resolve name, team, and stats.

annotations.description: Pointer to CCSPlayer_PingServices managing the in-game map-ping system.
CSPlayerState enum: STATE_ACTIVE = 0 (alive), STATE_WELCOME = 1, STATE_PICKINGTEAM = 2, STATE_PICKINGCLASS = 3, STATE_DEATH_ANIM = 4, STATE_DEATH_WAIT_FOR_KEY = 5, STATE_OBSERVER_MODE = 6.
True once the player moves after spawning; prevents accidental movement-triggered events.
Total duration in seconds of the current flash-bang blind effect (0 when not flashed).
Peak screen-overlay alpha (0–255) of the current flash bang; scales with proximity and facing angle.
GameTime at which the current progress bar (defuse/pickup) started.
Duration in seconds of the current progress bar interaction.
CHandle back to the CCSPlayerController that owns this pawn, even when a bot has taken over.
annotations.notes: Use this to map a pawn to its player for demo parsing.

annotations.description: Abstract base class shared by CCSPlayerPawn and CCSObserverPawn, providing the flash-bang state, progress bar, and original-controller link.
True while the player is escorting a hostage to the rescue zone.
WeaponPurchaseTracker_t recording which weapons were bought during the match (used for match-stats).
WeaponPurchaseTracker_t recording which weapons were bought this round (used for in-round stats and economy tracking).
Component tracking scoring-relevant actions: weapon purchases and hostage rescue status.
True while the player is escorting a hostage to the rescue zone.
WeaponPurchaseTracker_t recording which weapons were bought during the match (used for match-stats).
WeaponPurchaseTracker_t recording which weapons were bought this round (used for in-round stats and economy tracking).
Component tracking scoring-relevant actions: weapon purchases and hostage rescue status.
Cumulative number of bullet hits this player has registered on the server this round.
Component tracking bullet-hit statistics registered on the server side.
Cumulative number of bullet hits this player has registered on the server this round.
Component tracking bullet-hit statistics registered on the server side.
Vector of SellbackPurchaseEntry_t structs; each entry represents a weapon or equipment purchase that can still be sold back before freeze time expires.
Component that records the player's sellback-eligible purchases for the current round.
Vector of SellbackPurchaseEntry_t structs; each entry represents a weapon or equipment purchase that can still be sold back before freeze time expires.
Component that records the player's sellback-eligible purchases for the current round.
CHandle to the CHostage entity currently being carried by this player (INVALID_EHANDLE if none).
CHandle to the ragdoll/prop entity representing the carried hostage visually.
Component tracking whether this player is currently carrying a hostage.
CHandle to the CHostage entity currently being carried by this player (INVALID_EHANDLE if none).
CHandle to the ragdoll/prop entity representing the carried hostage visually.
Component tracking whether this player is currently carrying a hostage.
GameTime before which no weapon switch is permitted (e.g. after throwing a grenade).
annotations.notes: Only sent to the owning player (LocalPlayerExclusive).

annotations.description: Byte array encoding animation transition timing for the active weapon, used to synchronise viewmodel animations across client and server.
True when the inspect animation is suppressed until the animation graph ticks again (prevents stutter).
Component attached to CCSPlayerPawn that manages the active weapon and weapon-switch timing for a CS2 player.
GameTime before which no weapon switch is permitted (e.g. after throwing a grenade).
annotations.notes: Only sent to the owning player (LocalPlayerExclusive).

annotations.description: Byte array encoding animation transition timing for the active weapon, used to synchronise viewmodel animations across client and server.
True when the inspect animation is suppressed until the animation graph ticks again (prevents stutter).
Component attached to CCSPlayerPawn that manages the active weapon and weapon-switch timing for a CS2 player.
True when this team has surrendered the match (competitive FF vote passed).
Match-stat summary string displayed in the team header of the scoreboard (up to 512 bytes).
Number of maps this team has won in the current best-of-N series.
Number of rounds won by this team during the first half.
Number of rounds won by this team during the second half.
Number of rounds won by this team across all overtime periods.
Team organisation/clan name displayed in the scoreboard (up to 129 bytes; set by tournament operators).
Steam group / clan ID associated with this team (used for team logo lookup).
Short country/region flag code (up to 8 bytes) used to select the flag sprite (e.g. 'US', 'EU').
Short logo image name (up to 8 bytes) used to look up the team logo spray texture.

Server-side entity representing one team in a CS2 match (T or CT).  Two CCSTeam entities exist per match: one for teamnum 2 (Terrorist) and one for teamnum 3 (Counter-Terrorist).  Inherits the shared score from CTeam.
WeaponGameplayAnimState enum controlling the weapon's anim-graph state (idle, firing, reloading, inspecting, etc.).
GameTime at which an in-progress inspect cancel animation will finish.
True when an inspect animation has been queued but not yet started.
True when the inspect animation should loop (held-inspect mode).
CSWeaponMode enum: Primary_Mode = 0, Secondary_Mode = 1. Governs which attack function runs on fire.
Additive inaccuracy penalty accumulated by recent shots; decays over time. Feeds into the cone-spread calculation.
Integer index into the weapon's recoil table; incremented with each shot, decays when not firing.
Fractional recoil index for sub-step interpolation of the recoil pattern table.

annotations.description: True when the weapon is in burst-fire mode (e.g. Famas burst, Glock18 burst).
Tick after which a postponed shot will fire (used for the tick-aligned fire mechanism in sub-tick shooting).
Fractional tick ratio for m_nPostponeFireReadyTicks.
True while the weapon is performing its reload animation.
GameTime at which this weapon was dropped onto the ground.
True while the player is winding up to throw a grenade (held throw).
True when the suppressor is attached (M4A1-S / USP-S).
GameTime at which the suppressor attach/detach animation completes.
Team that originally spawned this weapon; buy-zone weapon pools are filtered by this.
Team of the player most recently holding this weapon.
True if the weapon was dropped close to a buy zone (affects whether bots will pick it up).
GameTime before which the previous owner cannot pick this weapon back up (prevents instant re-pickup after dropping).

Server tick on which the weapon was most recently dropped.
True if the weapon was the active weapon at the moment it was dropped.
GameTime of the most recent shot fired from this weapon.
Iron-sight zoom state (0 = none, 1 = iron-sighted).

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Material group (skin) to assign to use with the model.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: A weight determining the frequency at which this model is placed relative to other models within the detail type. The weights of all models are summed and the probability of selecting this model is its weight divided by the sum weight.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Screen space size [ 0, 1 ] (where 1 is the whole screen) at which the model will begin to to fade out. Anything larger will be fully visible, anything smaller will start to fade out.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Screen space size [ 0, 1 ] (where 1 is the whole screen) at which the model will be completely faded out. Anything smaller than this size will not be visible, anything larger will start fading in.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: If enabled, the up direction will be evaluated in world space, such that the object orientation does not affect the surface slope filtering. Additionally if Orient To Surface is 0, then and world space up is enabled, then the object orientation will not affect the rotation of detail model.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Value indicating if the model's up direction should be matched to the surface. Value should be in the [ 0, 1 ] range, where 0 means that the model up will be model (or object space) up and will ignore the surface direction, and 1 indicates that the model up will exactly match the surface normal.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum slope on which the target will be placed. Slope is a [ 0, 180 ] value based on the surface normal where horizontal surface (floor) is 0, vertical surface (wall) is 90, and a horizontal upside down surface (ceiling) is 180.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Maximum slope on which the target will be placed.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum range of random offset to apply along the model's local up direction

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Maximum range of random offset to apply along the model's local up direction

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum range of the random rotation to apply the model. Random rotation is applied in the local space of the model. Rotation values are ordered pitch, yaw, roll.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Maximum range of the random rotation to apply the model.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum random scale value to apply to the model.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Maximum random scale value to apply to the model.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum scale to apply to the model based the painted detail prop density. The minimum of the detail and blend weight scale values is multiplied with the random scale value to determine the final scale.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum scale to apply to the model based on the final material layer blend weight. The model will be given this scale value when the layer blend weight equals the minimum blend weight and will be 1.0 when the maximum blend weight has been reached. The minimum of the detail and blend weight scale values is multiplied with the random scale value to determine the final scale. Set this if you want the model to scale up as the material blend fades in. The smaller the value, the smaller the model will start as the material begins to fade in.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Minimum blend weight value for which the model will be placed. If the blend weight value is less than this value, the model will not be placed.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Maximum blend weight value for which the model will be placed. If the blend weight value is more than this value, the model will not be placed.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Blend weight at which the model will be at full density. Must be between the minimum and maximum blend weight values. The density of this model placement will increase with the blend weight value up to this value at which point it will be at full density.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Should instances of this model generate shadows in the lightmap. Note that shadows in the light map will persist even after the model fades out.

metadata.name: MPropertyDescription
metadata.value: Specifies the number of props placed per square foot.
